title: 1:1 meetings
intro: One-to-one talks with your manager or your people: an agenda, shared notes, private notes and action items.
nobody: You have no manager and no direct reports, so there is nobody to schedule a 1:1 with yet.
notFound: This meeting does not exist or you are not part of it.

notes.title: Notes
notes.sharedHint: Both of you can read and write these.
notes.privateHint: Only you can see these. Not the other person, not HR, not an administrator.

rule.no_manager: You have no manager to meet. Ask HR to set your manager.
rule.unknown_employee: This person cannot be met in a 1:1.
rule.nonexistent_time: This time does not exist on that day (the clocks change).
rule.not_participant: An action item belongs to one of the two people in the meeting.
rule.too_many: A meeting holds at most 20 action items.
rule.cancelled: This meeting was cancelled and can no longer be changed.
